summary: Backend P1 testing complete. Added 22 new tests to /app/backend/tests/test_courtbazaar_api.py covering: expanded courts/states (36 states, 426 courts), serviceability enforcement, Razorpay simulated payments, payment methods endpoint, notifications status + prefs + mock dispatch, Law Firm create/me/invite/accept/orders, Delivery partner full flow (queue/accept/location/complete + OTP validation), Document Intelligence (Claude), Sponsored Vendor plan/activate + priority matching. Also updated existing TestHealth.test_states (8 -> 36+) and TestCourts.test_courts_by_state_delhi (==10 -> >=10) to reflect expanded seed. Result: 57/58 passed. The single failure (TestAI.test_filing_checklist) is a pre-existing intermittent ingress 502 (gateway timeout) on slow LLM streaming, unrelated to P1 work — passed in iteration_1.

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 gateway timeout when Claude streaming exceeds ~60s ingress timeout. Same endpoint passed in iter_1. Recommend either streaming response back to client incrementally, or shorter prompt / non-stream mode, or increase ingress timeout. Mock notifications confirmed firing in backend logs.

action_items: Optional: address intermittent 502 on /api/ai/filing-checklist by making the LLM call non-streaming / shorter, OR raise ingress timeout. Not a P1 regression.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/delivery/{order_id}/location currently has no role-check — any authenticated user can spoof another delivery partner's GPS pings. Recommend: require role == 'delivery_partner' (or admin) AND require order.delivery_partner_id == user.user_id.
/api/delivery/{order_id}/complete has no role/ownership check either — any authenticated user supplying otp=123456 can mark any order delivered. Same fix as above.
Mock delivery OTP '123456' is hardcoded in server.py (line 1144). Acceptable for demo but should read from env (e.g., DELIVERY_OTP_MOCK) and be disabled when real OTP service is configured.
/api/firms/accept-invite does not validate that the logged-in user's email matches invite.email — anyone holding the token can accept on behalf of someone else.
/api/firms/invite sends email synchronously inside the request handler; can slow invite response if SendGrid is enabled. Consider BackgroundTasks.
server.py is 1281 lines — recommend extracting delivery, firms, doc-intel, notifications, razorpay endpoints into /app/backend/routes/* modules (the routes/ dir already exists but is empty).

/api/doc-intel/analyze: when Claude raises, returns 500 — but the prompt says it should return 200 with fallback defaults on JSON parse failure. The 500 path should also fall back to defaults so the UX stays consistent.
/api/payments/razorpay/create-order: no idempotency — calling twice on the same order creates duplicate payment_transactions rows. Consider upsert on order_id+gateway.
